Javier Kajika

A Warlords of New York target associated with the Pathway Park main mission in Lower Manhattan.

Pathway Park

Kajika is tied to Pathway Park in Lower Manhattan: Ubisoft identifies the park as his hiding place and separately identifies him as the mission's final encounter. [1][2]
